# [TASK] Service Integration Testing

## Task
Cross-service integration tests proving communication and data flow between movie/user/actor services through the gateway, gateway-boundary tests for routing/auth/error-handling/circuit-breaking/rate-limiting, and a Postman/newman acceptance-test gate.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Gateway-boundary suite passing — routing, auth, error propagation, circuit-breaker fallback, rate limiting (`GatewayIntegrationTest`: WireMock downstreams + Testcontainers Redis)
- [x] Full-stack journey suite passing against the live stack — favorites/watchlist round-trip, actor details + filmography, movies-by-actor (`FullStackJourneyIT`)
- [x] api-gateway module tests passing — 79/79 (75 gateway-boundary + 4 full-stack journey)
- [x] Postman/newman acceptance gate passing — 46/46 requests, 22/22 assertions
- [x] Integration testing strategy documented — `docs/architecture/INTEGRATION_TESTING.md`

## Estimate
**Hours:** 4-5

## Notes
- Coverage and performance are tracked per-module rather than as one cross-repo number — database-per-service (ADR-002) means there's no single meaningful figure. Formal load-test SLOs are a separate task (#45, Gatling), not duplicated here.
- Real commits: `eadfbff` (2026-07-21, gateway-boundary suite), `38ea0bd` (2026-07-23, full-stack journeys).
- Originally sized at 5 Story Points with no separate hour estimate recorded — Hours above is a retrospective conversion.
